stem: Among the following Newspapers of Bihar, which was the first one to get published?
expl: Among the given options, Patna Harkara started publication first. The newspapers/journals given in the options and their years of publication are as follows— Patna Harkara - 1855 Akhbar-e-Bihar - 1856 Bihar Bandhu - 1872 Bihar Herald - 1874 It is noteworthy that Noor-ul-Anwar, published from Ara in 1853, was the first newspaper of Bihar.

stem: Who highlighted the plight of the farmers of Champaran by writing under pseudonyms such as 'Dukhi', 'Dukhi Atma', 'Dukhi Hriday'?
expl: Pir Muhammad Munis, writing under the pen names ‘Dukhi’, ‘Dukhi Atma’ and ‘Dukhi Hriday’, highlighted the plight of the Champaran peasants by writing ‘Champaran Mein Andher’ (13 March, 1916), ‘Champaran Ki Durdasha’ (10 April, 1917) and ‘Dukhi Hriday’ (February, 1916). He also wrote articles on Mahatma Gandhi in Champaran, Hindu-Muslim unity, etc.

stem: Who was the Editor of Searchlight newspaper in Bihar?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: In Bihar, the publication of the Searchlight newspaper was started from Patna in 1918 by Dr. Sachchidanand Sinha. It began in 1918 as an English twice-weekly newspaper. In 1920 it became a thrice-weekly newspaper, and from 1930 it began to be published as a daily. Dr. Rajendra Prasad was one of the founders of this newspaper. Murli Manohar Prasad remained the editor of the Searchlight newspaper for a long period.
